facts.text: John mentioned a violin concert that he found last week, which he and others enjoyed.

evidence.quote: I just try to find things that we'll have fun with, like a walk or picnic in the park, or finding events in our town and beyond. Just last week, I found a violin concert that we all enjoyed.

facts.text: Maria shared that she got the idea for a castle-themed project from a trip to England a few years ago, where she was mesmerized by the castles.

evidence.quote: I got the idea from that trip to England a few years ago - I was mesmerized by the castles. I wanted to bring that same magic to my home, like a reminder of the world's beauty.

facts.text: Maria shared a photo of a castle in a shadow box, which John commented on as looking like something from a storybook.

evidence.quote: [image: a photo of a picture of a castle in a shadow box]
That pic is so cool! It looks like something from a storybook.

facts.text: Maria also shared a photo of a painting of a castle on a hill, which she created as a reminder of the beauty of the world.
